description: JPL Horizons observer tables (Sun and Earth) for the three south-polar site records of the data stream (data/sites/sites.json at commit f48b9c4 of the data branch). Same query parameters as validation/horizons/cases.json. Longitude east, planetocentric latitude and height above the 1737.4 km sphere are copied from the site records (ground_height_m_above_1737.4km_sphere / 1000); no observer height above the ground is added. The sites are project candidate points, not official landing sites.

spans.note: the twelve-month window of validation/sites/scenario.json, 25-hour step so that the hour of day drifts
